div.head: II Cn 68.1c
div.ab: And ægþer man sceal ge on godcundan scriftan ge on woruldcundan doman þas þingc tosceadan.
And ægðer man sceall ge on godcundan scr[i]ftan ge on woruldcundan doman þæs þincg toseaden.
Et utrobique debet hoc diligenter aduerti tam in diuinis legibus (penitentiis diuinis) quam in secularibus iudiciis.
And æðer man sceal, ge on godcundan scriftum ge on woruldcundan dome, ðas ðincg tosceadan.
And ægþer man sceal ge on godcundan scriftan ge on woruldcundan doman þas þingc tosceadan.
And discrimination with regard to these circumstances must be shown both in [imposing] ecclesiastical amends and in [passing] secular judgment.
And these considerations must be weighed when assigning spiritual penance and secular judgment.
And these things are to be distinguished both in religious penances and in secular judgments.
Und diese Umstände muss man unterscheiden sowohl bei geistlichen Bussen wie bei weltlichen [-em B] Urtheilen.
And one must distinguish these circumstances both in spiritual penances and in secular judgments (judgment, B).
